title: Brand Strategy & Positioning
description: Build brands that stand for something in crowded markets. Tests positioning statements, competitive mapping, and brand architecture.

seo.overviewBody: Brand positioning dictates how a company sets itself apart from competitors in the minds of consumers. Strategists evaluate candidates on brand positioning statements, target customer persona profiles, brand tone of voice guidelines, and messaging hierarchies.

deliverables.title: 1. Brand Positioning & Messaging Architecture Spec
deliverables.desc: Strategic document outlining brand vision, core positioning statement, competitive differentiators, and messaging pillars.

deliverables.title: 2. Target Customer Persona Profiles
deliverables.desc: Detailed buyer personas defining demographics, psychographics, key pain points, and decision triggers.

deliverables.title: 3. Brand Voice & Style Guidelines
deliverables.desc: Tone-of-voice guide establishing brand personality traits, vocabulary preferences, and do's & don'ts examples.

faqs.question: How do you write a classic brand positioning statement?
faqs.answer: Structure: For [target audience], [Brand Name] is the [category] that [key benefit] because [reason to believe].

faqs.question: Why are negative buyer personas useful?
faqs.answer: Negative personas represent customer types you do NOT want to target (e.g. low budget, high support friction), preventing wasted ad spend.

faqs.question: How do you maintain brand voice consistency across multiple copywriters?
faqs.answer: Provide concrete 'We write like THIS, not like THAT' side-by-side copy examples in the brand style guide.
